name: OOP 2027
description: Long-running German conference on software architecture and engineering
note: Conference + workshop day, German and English; early bird until 4 Dec 2026; prices net
details: Four days with up to 7 parallel tracks, about 150 speakers and 120+ talks, keynotes and workshops. Prices net (+19% VAT): 1-day Flex-Ticket 990 EUR, 3-day Conference Pass 2,490 EUR (early bird 1,992 EUR), 4-day Full Conference Pass 2,990 EUR (early bird 2,392 EUR); early bird valid until 4 December 2026, alumni discount available. The official site names the venue SCC München; the street address is from a venue listing (messen.de), not the organizer page. Organized by heise conferences / SIGS.
